basis.saw: Grouped bar chart with error bars, y 'Accuracy (pct)' 0-100, x 'Model Name' with ~24 LLMs, legend PubHealthBench-Full (light blue) and -Reviewed (red), dotted lines 'Est. Upper Bound' and 'Human Average'; left panel of Fig. 1.

narrative.text: Fig. 1 (left): MCQA accuracy per model on PubHealthBench-Full (light blue) and PubHealthBench-Reviewed (red), with error bars. Models run from Gemma-3-1B (about 46-48%) up to GPT-4.5 (about 92%); most models sit around 72-88%. Two dotted horizontal lines mark 'Est. Upper Bound' (about 97%) and 'Human Average' (about 88%).

basis.saw: Bar chart with error bars and percentage labels, y 'Accuracy (pct)' 0-100, single series PubHealthBench-FreeForm; right panel of Fig. 1.

narrative.text: Fig. 1 (right): free-form accuracy per model on PubHealthBench-FreeForm, ascending from Gemma-3-1B (18%) through e.g. GPT-4o (61%), o3-Mini (70%), GPT-4.1 (71%) to o1 (74%), with error bars.

basis.saw: Three rounded panels each with a multiple-choice question and options A-G, one option outlined in green; panel labels Clinical, Professional, Public Guidance; Fig. 2.

narrative.text: Fig. 2: three example PubHealthBench MCQA questions, one each for Clinical Guidance (NOx exposure observation duration, answer A '24 to 36 hours'), Professional Guidance (nitric acid spill emergency action code, answer E '2R') and Public Guidance (Zika travel advice timing, answer G 'At least 4 to 6 weeks before they travel'); correct options boxed in green.

basis.saw: Pipeline diagram: GOV.UK documents -> chunks -> LLM boxes -> Question/Options -> LLM filter -> green check or red cross -> Join with Chunk/Doc/Metadata, with stage captions; Fig. 3.

narrative.text: Fig. 3: MCQA generation pipeline. Stages left to right: extract UKHSA guidance free text; split into section chunks with headers; LLM filter to chunks with public-health information (one chunk rejected in red); LLM generates question and options grounded in a chunk; automated LLM filtering using source text (one question passes with a green check, one fails with a red cross); join into the full benchmark with chunk, document and metadata.

basis.saw: Three-step workflow diagram in blue, orange and green dashed panels with reviewer icons, review protocol boxes, check/cross/question marks and chart icons; Fig. 5.

narrative.text: Fig. 5: benchmark review steps. Step 1: initial double human review of 150 MCQA samples, then compare annotations and align. Step 2: single human review of the remaining 650 samples to estimate the benchmark error rate. Step 3: humans answer 600 questions with a search engine to estimate a human baseline.
